name: PureLink VCX2 RX (HCD) — silk print replica

cutouts: Fusion cut-out SVG: Cut-outs trace each connector’s visible outline, not the manufacturer’s recommended panel cut-out with clearance and tolerance.

Rear panel: supplier drawing V1.1 draws the ports view rotated 180° (upside-down) relative to how the panel actually mounts; all rear-panel positions below were corrected by mirroring both axes (real_x = 240 − raw_x, real_y = 30 − raw_y), not signed off against the physical part.
DC 24V (4-pin DIN power jack): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1 (HDPRX-EUB40HCD-DE0012), not signed off.
RS-232 (Phoenix, 3-pin): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
RJ45, ETHERNET: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.

RJ45/Amphenol, VCX input (front panel): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off; the connector body's own "Amphenol" branding text visible in the drawing is the connector manufacturer's own moulded marking, not a silkscreen label, and was not reproduced.
USB-B, USB HOST (front panel): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
USB-A, DEVICE 1/2: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
USB-C, DEVICE 3 / SERVICE / rear OUTPUT: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
HDMI (front INPUT, rear OUTPUT): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
Phoenix 5-pin, AUDIO (rear OUTPUT): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.

Ground screw (M4) x4 (front INPUT frame, rear DEVICE frame, rear OUTPUT frame): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1; the drawing's own icon reads smaller than this tool's fixed M4 ground-screw art, not signed off.
LED push button, AUTO/3S and OUTPUT: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
LED (power, LINK, and the four small unlabeled-function status LEDs beside AUTO/3S and OUTPUT): positions estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
silkscreen: Silkscreen SVG: Silk artwork replicated from the supplier's own silkprint drawing V1.1 (2026-10-20, HDCVT / Shenzhen Wanshi Technology 深圳市玩视科技有限公司); dimensions on that drawing are guides only (drawn in red) and were not treated as exact. Not compared against production silk files.

The drawing's top (lid) view, left/right side views, and the separate bottom-face legend rectangle (Rating Label / MAC address / NOTES) were used only as context (and to cross-check chassis width/height against the panel outline) — not reproduced as additional panels.

Rear panel: corrected from the drawing's 180°-rotated ports view (see cutouts note); frame titlePos chosen so that, after correction, each frame's own title sits at the top and each member's function label breaks the frame's bottom border, matching the as-drawn relationship once both axes are flipped. The rotation-corrected reading (DEVICE numbered 1→2→3 ascending left to right; RS-232 reading TX/GND/RX left to right) matches standard convention, used as a sanity check that the correction was applied the right way round.
HDMI, RJ45 (ETHERNET, VCX): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
USB-A (DEVICE 1/2), USB-B (USB HOST): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
USB-C (DEVICE 3, SERVICE, rear OUTPUT): estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.
Phoenix 3-pin (RS-232): pin order read off the rotated drawing and corrected (reversed) to "TX, [gnd], RX" left to right; estimated, not signed off.
Phoenix 5-pin (AUDIO): pin order read off the rotated drawing and corrected (reversed) to "+, −, [gnd], +, −" with L on pins 1-2 and R on pins 4-5; estimated, not signed off.
Ground screw (M4) x4: estimated from supplier silkprint drawing V1.1, not signed off.

AUTO/3S and OUTPUT are modelled as LED push-buttons per the drawing's own square button glyph; the four small round icons beside them (labelled HDMI/VCX near the INPUT frame, and HDMI/USB-C near the OUTPUT button) are modelled as status LEDs — their exact function (active-source / active-output indication) is inferred from their position next to the two buttons and is not stated on the drawing itself; not signed off.

LED (power, LINK, and the four status LEDs): colours assumed red (power) / green (all others) by PureLink convention — the drawing itself is monochrome line art with no colour callouts for LEDs; not signed off.
